acceptance_predicates.description: The control-state ownership failure is reproduced or its environmental cause is documented with exact evidence.
Production backend idempotency tests use unique bounded state roots and preserve real ownership/recovery semantics.
Focused and full workspace tests pass without weakening coverage or quality gates.
Paired AR-1632 and AR-1615 clean-room qualification is not exposed to cross-test state collisions.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only.

definition_of_done: Signed repair is merged on protected ASB main.
Independent review and all required hosted checks are green.

inputs.description: ASB production control backend and idempotency recovery tests.
Existing hosted coverage, policy, and supply-chain workflows.

outputs.description: Deterministic control-state ownership test and qualification evidence.

gates.description: Focused and full local tests pass.
Required hosted checks pass on the exact reviewed head.
